name: Intestinal epithelium
failures: Barrier failure, inflammatory destruction, malignant transformation. Renews every few days.

see.note: Endoscopy and biopsy are routine and direct.

model.note: Continuous renewal from a defined stem compartment.

reach.note: Oral delivery reaches the lumen; targeting epithelial cells specifically is unsolved.

edit.note: No approved cell-directed therapy; immunosuppression treats the driver instead.

verify.note: Endoscopic healing is a validated endpoint.

anchors: Crypt stem cell renewal is among the fastest in the body
